subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this narrow run/harness/context bucket policy, the broader all-duration policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or a different metric-default policy before merge?
rationale: Both branches change existing exported metric aggregation defaults, and automation cannot safely choose the operator compatibility policy or resolve the competing scopes.

options.title: Choose one policy with proof
options.body: Select the intended bucket scope, require redacted real OTel export proof on the selected branch, and close or supersede the other branch after that path is settled.

options.title: Accept this narrow policy
options.body: Proceed with only run, harness, and context buckets if maintainers want minimal metric-layout churn and the contributor adds real export proof.

options.title: Favor the broader policy
options.body: Pause this PR in favor of the related broader duration-bucket branch if maintainers want consistency across all millisecond duration histograms.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy with proof
recommendation.body: Select the intended bucket scope, require redacted real OTel export proof on the selected branch, and close or supersede the other branch after that path is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on diagnostics-otel metric/exporter behavior and the OpenTelemetry v2 migration.
